name: Reel In
summary: A link import that casts a fishing line for your file, checks the link, reels it in and lands it in a library
about: Reel In is an import-from-link field set on a little dock by the sea. The link you paste is checked for real (missing https:// added, only web links allowed, the file name and type read from the address), then the rod draws back and casts, the bobber nibbles while the host is found and bites when the file details come in. The reel winds the line home as the progress runs, and the file leaps out of the water into your library. The network part is simulated, so no request leaves your browser.
how: Paste a link to a file, or press one of the sample chips.
Press Reel in (or Enter); a bad link shakes the field and says why.
Watch the four steps: check the link, find the host, read the file info, reel it in.
The file lands in the library with its type and size; Copy link copies the address.
